newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling steady on dollar, up on pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling steady on dollar, up on pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling ended the week unchanged against the dollar and up on the pound, the central bank said on Friday.
The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 600.1380, unchanged from Thursday and last Friday.
Against the pound, the shilling gained, exchanging at a mean rate of 955.4227 compared to Thursday's rate of 959.8037.
Financial analysts and dealers told Reuters they expected the shilling to continue to remain stable in the short term.
"The outlook for the shilling looks stable. There's less demand for dollars -- importation has slowed so the shilling is strengthening," said a commercial bank treasury official.
The dealer said the market could remain slow on expectations of reduced taxes and levies in a June budget.
